description: Manages and provides access to the hierarchical structure of an organization, detailing relationships between different organizational units or departments.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationHierarchy
endpoints.description: Retrieves the current and complete organizational hierarchy of the system, showing all active organizational units and their relationships.
example_uses: Show me the current organizational chart.
I need to see the full structure of the organization.
What are all the departments and how do they relate?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to view the entire, up-to-date organizational structure for planning, reporting, or general information.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationHierarchyLegacy
endpoints.description: Retrieves a legacy version of the organizational hierarchy, potentially for historical data access or compatibility with older systems. This might represent a previous structure or a specific data format.
example_uses: Can I get the old organizational hierarchy?
I need to access the legacy org chart for a historical report.
Retrieve the organizational structure as it was in the previous system.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you specifically require access to an older or legacy representation of the organizational hierarchy, typically for historical analysis, migration, or compatibility purposes.
